author: researcher
excerpt: The chart on these pages show the average intake over a given time span. You can change the time span shown by time selection buttons below the chart.
observation: MacroFactor help article 'View Weekly Nutrition Averages'. From the main dashboard's Nutrition section the user taps a nutrient; the chart shows average intake over a selectable time span, and the user can swipe to other periods.
limitations: Vendor help text, undated, not observed in the app. Does not state the available time spans, the week start, whether unlogged days are included in the average, or whether a change from the previous period is shown.
